coordinates: RH column vectors, Hamilton wxyz; authored assembly uses X front/Y side/Z up. Original intrinsic Y-X-Z conversion formulas retained; do not relabel them as our Z-axis example.
renderer: Existing Manim math and new fixed assembly models; no duplicated engine scene.

models.representation: Object held at defined Z45 or Z90 while axis-angle/quaternion/matrix text changes.
models.columns: For Rz90, X maps to(0,1,0) and Z to(0,0,1); compare equal input axes.
models.twist: Rotate about the current body X axis: red direction stays fixed, blue up changes.
models.actualRotation: R→q keeps pose; subsequent extra Z45 visibly changes Z90 toZ135.
models.camera: World pose fixed; only viewing camera moves.
